My plans

Every plan you work on is kept in this browser, on this device, until you delete it here or clear browsing data. Save to a file for a copy you can share or keep elsewhere.

User guide

MIG entitlements

One line per entitlement: the ranks, then the area in m². A room whose name contains a rank is checked against it.

Snapshots & compare

A snapshot captures the whole building — every floor, the roof and the site. Compare later to see what was added, changed or removed.
